name: D & H India Limited
about: D & H India Limited engages in manufacturing of welding electrodes in India. It offers SMAW/MMAW consumables, tig and mig wires, flux cored wires, submerged arc welding fluxes and wires, and low heat input/repair and maintenance welding electrode. The company also provides CO2 wires, flux powder, and stainless steel wires. It serves power, oil and petrochemical, steel, railway, cement plant, sugar and distillery, earth moving and mining, ship building and marine, and heavy engineering fabrication sectors. The company was formerly known as D&H Welding Electrodes (India) Ltd. and changed its name to D & H India Limited in April 2012. D & H India Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Indore, India.
